reviews.title: Calendar View Alteration
reviews.text: I’m a long time user of Paceline. Please bring back in calendar view the ability to see which days of the current week have been exercised on without having to fully click into the week. I want to please be able to open the calendar and see via a symbol on the calendar day if I worked out on a certain day or not. Bringing this back I think would help a lot of people feel more positively again about the app. The main use of the app for a lot of ppl is that calendar view and the ability to look at the calendar and see which days were worked out for the week and which days weren’t.

reviews.title: This app sucks now

I would exchange them for target and Starbucks gift cards and it was really a lot of fun. Now, all of the rewards are not anything that I’m interested in. Bring back the gift cards and I will redownload the app.

reviews.title: No longer worthy app

reviews.title: Not worth it anymore
reviews.text: I used to get a dollar to amazon, then the points changed and now the rewards are the same as if you googled a discount code. Nothing special. And this update took the one thing the was still worth it - the calendar view of workouts. It’s how I looked back to see what I did over the month, but now it’s gone. App isn’t worth it anymore.

reviews.title: Long time user
reviews.text: I have used the app for literal years at this point, I had a 188 week streak and now suddenly the app isnt synching all of my data.  I lost my streak and my points and customer service keeps telling me it is fixed.  Very disappointing!

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: It used to be great. This latest update where you can no longer see a calendar and a daily breakdown of your minutes is frustrating. Add this latest update to the bad marketplace and I might have to find something else. The developers don’t understand the “if it ain’t broke don’t fix it” logic. Stop changing!!

reviews.title: Getting progressively worse
reviews.text:
I have been using Paceline for years. When I first started the rewards were gift cards to places people would actually go to, and then they did away with that in place of discounts for stuff most people don’t want . Then they did away with being able to see your friend’s minutes and support them and challenge them. Now they have the “social challenges” that the app arbitrarily decides whether its intensity minutes or steps. I’m actively looking for something that had the old features, even if there are no rewards, and I will probably be deleting my account with PaceLine soon. It is a shame because like I said I have been using this app for years and kept recommending it to people and now every update they do they change the interface and take away features that people liked. 

The only reason it gets 2* is because I used to really like it.

reviews.title: App has been broken for a while
reviews.text: Requires you to “recreate” your account everytime you open it. Literally asks for your name and phone number everytime. Not worth the hassle. Deleting it

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Service, Deleting App
reviews.text: When I first started using this app, it was really awesome and I hade ZERO issues. Now, over the last several months, every so often, I have an issue where the data is missing for a day and when I reach out with proof , they would manually add it for me. For some reason, I reached out a few days ago and am getting pushback stating it won’t be added manually with the nastiest response. On top of that, the 2 tickets I submitted were just closed without out reviewing, resolution or response by a Heather S, Customer Support Manager. She could use a few lessons is etiquette and proper customer service, horrible nasty attitude. Something that was once an enjoyable incentive for exercising has not become a hassle and no longer worth dealing with. Plus, most of the stuff being offered is just you using your point to get hostile discounts on nothing most would want to spend money on. The free gift cards were better. Using my remaining points, deleting the app and moving on. Don’t bother using it, just a waste of time.

reviews.title: Limited actual rewards minimal reason to use
reviews.text:
The rewards marketplace is a joke there’s like one decent option outside of the app you can use being Starbucks and that’s spiked in price since the app launched. They used to have Amazon and target gift cards and the rewards were actually incentive ….. now if I want a coffee honestly less of a pain to just buy it vs compile 40,000 points for a 5$ card. 

You used to be good and actually helpful with the rewards you offered. Do better or just let the app die all together because this….. this isn’t it. 

Disappointed doesn’t even begin to cover it with what the app had when it first started.

Yes you’ve added new ways to fan points but that doesn’t help anything if the rewards aren’t good save like one and you’ve raised the cost of that one more and more .

reviews.title: Bring back the real rewards
reviews.text: I used to love this app! The Amazon, Starbucks, and other gift cards (even though they were for small amounts) were a great motivator. They also had awards where you could donate to charitable organizations which I loved. Now the only rewards are for the Paceline marketplace. Even if you earn a gift card amount…you still have to pay (for example, they’ll give you a discounted price if you use a certain amount of points…not possible to pay for an item fully with points even if you have a ton saved up). I’ve been waiting for a while for the app to get better but I am leaning towards deleting my account.

reviews.title: Punishes Healthy People
reviews.text:
So the data doesn’t seem to take into account healthiness and physical fitness, as that makes it more difficult to increase your heart rate, meaning the ranges it needs you to achieve are even harder to obtain, as if they weren’t difficult enough to obtained based on how vague the descriptions are in the app.

Say you’ve got a 15min workout where your avg heart rate is 160bpm, the app will only count maybe half of that if you’re lucky, which is really a huge pain.

The biggest issue I’ve noticed too is the “Leaderboards.” As you see people with insane numbers that make you question if they’re actually legitimate. For example, you see some people with almost 3hrs of exercise minutes within the first day a new leaderboard starts, which seems feasible, but then as the week progressed, you being seeing people with upwards of 10hrs, which is insane when you take everything into consideration.

The fact the app doesn’t explicitly say what heart rate range counts towards exercise minutes for it makes it even more of a pain since you end up doing a brutal workout for over an hour to only be rewarded with a mere fraction of that time as “exercise minutes.” It just doesn’t add up to me, and the lack of a moving average makes it punish healthy and fit people and have them not want to use the app in the long-run.

There is a lot of potential here though if the app gets things sorted out.

reviews.title: Points Increase to Earn Gift Cards
reviews.text:
EDIT: They increased the points to earn Starbucks gift cards by A TON 

I really enjoyed using Paceline, it was a great motivator, especially when I could redeem a gift card every couple of months. But lately, it feels like the number of points needed to redeem rewards keeps going up. Even though I consistently earn the maximum points each week, it now looks like it’ll take several months before I can redeem anything.

Also, I added myself to the waitlist for the Paceline card years ago, but I’ve never heard anything back. Just wanted to share some feedback as a longtime and engaged user.

reviews.title: Getting worse

So I sign up, fork over dozens of data points and when I look at the rewards section: no gift cards. Just coupons off merchandise they sell and brands I’ve never even heard of. Lame! All the recent reviews point this out but I went by their own description.

reviews.title: App Has Gone Downhill Significantly
reviews.text:
I first downloaded this app a few years ago. It was a nice way to get little rewards for being active. Even if refreshing the app / activity every few days for a few weeks only resulted in a $1 Amazon Gift Card, it was more than I had before for not doing any extra “work”. 
Since then, they updated the app so the only non-Paceline gift card is Starbucks. Anyone with half a brain can draw the conclusion that the Paceline gift card rewards cost them nothing and aren’t a reward. It’s essentially a credit on something you wouldn’t buy normally and if you did, you can 100% get it cheaper elsewhere (like on Amazon). 
I’ve still kept the app because why not add $5 to my Starbucks app every now & then for doing my normal activity. NOW, I open the app thinking I’m close to the 25k points that were previously needed for the Starbucks gift card and I see they’ve increased it to 40k points (for the same $5 gift card). I understand the cost of everything is high but unfortunately this gives all the red flags that the app is going under. Nice while it lasted but certainly not worth a download anymore.

reviews.title: Paceline
reviews.text: Initially i thought it was cool, but you don’t get rewards. the discounts are on over priced items. And there’s no reason to buy them when you can get them cheaper somewhere else. It has good potential but seems like they don’t currently update it.

reviews.title: Raised Starbucks gift cards 66%
reviews.text:
This app has gone through many changes over the years losing value along the way, but I just went to cash in 24,000 reward points for a $5 Starbucks gift card and see it’s gone up to 40,000 points.   A 66% increase is pretty silly.    

It’s still simple to use just takes a lot longer.  You can decide how much your data is worth.  I’ll ride it out at this point but personally wouldn’t start new with the app with its current redemption value but that’s an individual choice.

reviews.title: Little Reward
reviews.text: I have used this app for over 4 years and have watched the decline of value for the user. $1 Amazon cards and $5 target cards are a thing of the past with the points you “earn” being worthless unless you spend your own money on the marketplace. Having a 204 week streak currently keeps me motivated to hit my exercise minutes, but without this in place I wouldn’t even give the app a 1 star review. I’m not sure why there aren’t any items you can fully use points on and pay for shipping if necessary but with 57,000 points just sitting there seems pointless.

reviews.title: Finally Deleting
reviews.text: Used to be fun to exchange points for small gift cards to places I actually used. Was a great little reward for being active! Rewards are useless now, never even heard of 95% of the brands and the discounts just aren’t worth it. Would be better if could use a higher number of points for a bigger discount, but I don’t see that as an option. Kept hoping the developers would realize the new setup doesn’t encourage engagement with the app and turn things around, but alas, much time has gone by and no change. No point to this particular app anymore, may as well use any of the many other fitness apps instead. Finally deleting today.

reviews.title: Pointless

This app doesn’t really make any sense unless you’re entering giveaways with all of your points. Any“deal” that they have is the most expensive I’ve seen any of these products priced at. You’re asking a customer to go through a third-party to spend more money, which makes no sense. I have 40,000 points and nothing to use them on because everything is only 1000 points. Plus the full price of
The item on their website site or more. I used to be able to get six packs of beverages to try for 6000 points. Where are those deals?

reviews.title: No longer worth it
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for years and have not missed a streak in over three years. At first I really liked it and would check on my progress often and regularly shop the rewards section to decide what I would like to spend my points on.  Even though the rewards were only $1-$5 it was still fun and motivating.  

All the gift cards and anything that could be considered a reward have been replaced with coupons for nominal discounts on fairly expensive products. Some of the products could be good but I’m not familiar with many of them and 5% off retail is simply not enough to get me to spend money to try something I might not even like. 

Now I find myself opening the app once a month or so to see if anything has changed or gotten better but have only to be disappointed. This is a great concept but with the credit card failed and the lack of a comparable rewards structure, it’s been executed poorly.

reviews.title: Started out great but has fallen woefully short.
reviews.text:
I have been using Paceline for about 5 years. In the beginning the reward options were great even getting the occasional gift cards for Starbucks, Target or Amazon. Even the $1 cards were enough to get me to work towards something. Since the update to the points system the rewards are just not something I care about additional points expire after a period of time so trying to save up is moot. 

Perhaps Paceline could start to incorporate some other type of rewards. For example Ifit would reward certain workout or milestones with simple magnets, and occasionally medals for things like races.

reviews.title: Not what it used to be
reviews.text: You used to earn gift cards for pace points. Now the not options are high priced minimal brand option products. If I have 8000 pace points that should earn me a small gift card. Demotivating.

reviews.title: Gift cards gone
reviews.text: No more gift cards offered like the past. Now only very small discounts on expensive products they want you to spend your money on. Can’t even donate to good causes unless you have like 10,000 points which equates to a measly $4. What a joke. Bring back how this app used to be.

Now you can only redeem your points for discounts on products, mostly random supplements you don’t need to be healthy. I won’t be using this app anymore.
